quote: What an exceptional tour! Interesting throughout, lively, engaging and informative presentation by Frank de Planta who has remarkable expertise in this area. Good humour and an enthusiastic approach tuned to meet the needs of everyone in the party meant that we all enjoyed and learned from the tour. Many of the testimonials come from military personnel but the tour (Cassino) will appeal to those with considerable knowledge or none at all. Our group reflected this diversity of interest. I cannot recommend highly enough.
name: Stephen Nokes
